name: Procore
positioning: The construction record of truth — where the owner, the general contractor and every sub look at the same drawing set.
description: Procore is a construction management platform covering preconstruction, project management, quality and safety, design coordination, and financials. Its commercial model charges the owner or contractor by construction volume and gives unlimited free seats to subcontractors and collaborators.
real_estate_use: On a development, disputes are usually about which version of a document someone was working from. Procore holds the drawings, RFIs, submittals, daily logs, change orders and photos in one place, so the developer's project manager, the architect and the concrete sub all reference the same record. Financial modules then tie change orders to the budget the investor sees.
features: Drawing, RFI and submittal management with version control
Daily logs, photos and site documentation
Change order, budget and commitment tracking
Quality and safety inspections with punch lists
Unlimited free collaborator seats for subcontractors

use_cases.job: Keep a development's document, change order and budget history in one auditable place
Receive a complete closeout package with as-builts and warranties at handover

capabilities: Document search and summarisation across project records
